product_one_liner.value: Haptiq is an AI-powered enterprise operations platform that unifies business data, automates workflows, and delivers real-time decision intelligence for enterprises, asset managers, governments, institutions, and family offices.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer presents contact/demo pathways but no public pricing link.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index is a marketing and product-insights blog; it does not show at least two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The site exposes an FAQ but no public documentation site, help center, or developer portal with several product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current listings include a Data Engineer role, which does not qualify under the requested title rule, and no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The CTO/CEO profile publicly describes Haptiq's production multi-agent architecture as built on OpenAI.

last_funding.notes: The amount is not publicly disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified outside-financing event was the April 2022 buyout, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current listings include sales-titled roles, including Director, Sales & Go-to-Market and Director of Sales.

launched_6mo.notes: The May 28, 2026 product update describes new Orion connectors and new Olympus Credit compliance functionality, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Alon Tvina's profile shows his Haptiq CEO tenure ending in September 2026, while Rich Davis's profile shows him becoming CEO in October 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The product update names Zoho as a newly supported connector.
